references.text: Describes holy convocations (מִקְרָא־קֹדֶשׁ) in connection with the Feast of Unleavened Bread, using the same terminology as Leviticus 23:2
Lists the Lord's appointed feasts (מוֹעֲדֵי יְהוָה) that Israel is to celebrate three times a year
Mentions appointed times (מוֹעֲדֵיכֶם) when trumpets are to be blown over the offerings
Introduces instructions for offerings at the appointed times (בְּמוֹעֲדוֹ)
Summarizes the offerings to be brought on the Lord's appointed feasts (בְּמוֹעֲדֵיכֶם)
Solomon celebrates the feasts at the appointed times according to Moses' command
The Lord expresses displeasure with their appointed feasts (מוֹעֲדֵיכֶם), highlighting the seriousness of observing them correctly
Prophesies that the Lord will put an end to her feasts (מוֹעֲדֶיהָ) as judgment
Paul writes that feasts and Sabbaths were a shadow of what was to come, fulfilled in Christ
Urges not to neglect meeting together (ἐπισυναγωγὴν), continuing the principle of holy assemblies
